change.title: Disabled-User Session Revocation
change.defect: Existing sessions remained valid after a user account was suspended or inactivated, and session validation did not check the current user status.
change.fix: Session validation now rejects non-ACTIVE users and revokes that session immediately. Changing a user to SUSPENDED or INACTIVE revokes all of that user's active sessions and records the revoked-session count in the audit payload.
